notes: Names without suffix (DAYTON, EXETER, YORK, GARDEN, HULBERT printed without AV. here but AV. on key map) recorded as '... Street' except Hulbert Avenue (key map). Bank Street runs along the top edge but its centreline lies at or above the paper edge (south line y~100-160, 50 ft wide), so McLean/Bank, Alley/Bank, Western/Bank, Winchell/Bank and Riddle Alley/Bank are not recorded (sheet 224 side). Findlay Street's north line is at y~7490 and its centre (~7640) is just on the paper, so McLean/Findlay is recorded; Western Avenue reaches Findlay off the east edge. McLean centre taken midway between its west line (212 outline, x~220-245) and east line (x~808-822). Western Avenue is straight (dx/dy ~0.68); centreline x = 2895 + 0.679*(y-1749). The unnamed 12 ft diagonal alley's NW end opens into the McLean/Bank corner (centreline would meet Bank near x~700, y~5, off the paper). The E-W alley at y~815 and the 12' alley at y~800 on sheet 212 line up across McLean. Mapping stops at x~6100 east of Winchell (sheet 214); Garden, Dayton, York Alley and York continue east there. A 10 ft opening on the south side of York at x~6000 at the mapping edge is not recorded. The two 12 ft E-W alleys off McLean (y~815 and y~2488) end at the diagonal alley (x~1260 and ~2407); alley-to-alley junctions are not recorded as intersections.
